examples.worked_solution:
The vertex of a downward-opening parabola is the highest point of the parabola.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14096579/assets/fb7fa7a4dcc4c7746122cd01a79a03584eb74c2ce9439859910699278e971a56.png)

  

Therefore, the coordinates of the vertex are $(4,3).$
